text_block_list.name: Mid-Level Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Finally... she's finally running in a mock race.
Man, talk about kicking off the new year with a bang!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Right after New Year's. At the trainers' meeting in the gymnasium, my colleagues were buzzing with unusual excitement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, tomorrow "that young heiress" would finally make her mock race debut.
Just who would end up becoming her trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to working with you all today, everyone. And also...
Thank you, Kita-chan. I'm so glad you could make it♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe! There's no way I'd miss Dia-chan's big debut race!
I had to rush right over!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: As someone who debuted first, I'm ready to give you everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I'd say "go easy on me"... but who am I kidding?
You've never once held back on me in a race, right, Kita-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Nope! Whenever I run, I give it everything I've got!
Especially when you're my opponent, Dia-chan!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today's star is Satono Diamond, daughter of the prestigious Satono Group.
Her chief rival is her close friend and natural-born leader, Kitasan Black.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just how boundless is Satono Diamond's talent?
The gates finally open, kicking off the race.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaah! All right, blitzed the front, perfect start!
I'm gonna push all the way through from the lead!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Still... if anyone can catch up, it's Dia-chan.
She's always stayed right on my heels!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (She's already pulled ahead this much...?! As expected of Kita-chan...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(And the pack around me... Agh, are they intentionally closing in on me?!
Ngh, I can't break out to the right or left... But still...!)

text_block_list.name: Young Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Father, Mother, I make this promise to you.
I swear I will make the Satono family's dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I have prepared for this all my life. So many instructors, so much training,
so much research, and so many... expectations!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Hold back a little longer. Not yet—
I want to surge, I want to go... but I have to watch and wait...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
(Alright, final corner...! Did I push a little too hard?
Still, I controlled the pace all the way here. Even Dia-chan won't be able to—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—!! Her momentum faltered!
Now—!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Huh? Whaaaaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: (WHOAAAAAAA!!)

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
She overtook Kitasan Black... by a nose?!
Before she's even debuted? This girl really is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
A truly diamond-class prodigy...!
I must sign a contract with her...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
U-Um, what is with this crowd...?
...Kita-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
What else? They're all trainer candidates who came to see you, Dia-chan!
Ahhh... You totally stole the spotlight from me. I don't know whether to be mad or happy~

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Trainer candidates...! Is that so?!
To think so many respected trainers were watching me...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—I am deeply honored.
I must redouble my efforts and dedicate myself even further.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running was magnificent. Reading the crucial turning point with precision,
and unleashing her innate explosive acceleration right on cue...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Truly the culmination of raw talent and elite upbringing. While a few
subtle weaknesses inherent to sheltered prodigies showed... even those felt like room to grow.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you're a trainer too, aren't you? You were watching pretty intently.
Wasn't Dia-chan just incredible?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
She's been fast since we were kids, but lately her late-kick is even sharper!
Man, she's got my absolute hundred-percent endorsement!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to her best friend Kitasan's enthusiastic praise, I gaze at Satono Diamond
in the distance. A golden egg of the highest caliber. Limitless potential. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A flower on a high peak. The heiress of an immense fortune. She felt like someone
an ordinary trainer shouldn't approach on mere enthusiasm alone.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Over in the stands, having a friendly chat with Kita-chan...
Who could that be...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Aren't they... going to come over? But they looked like they had so much
they wanted to say to me. And they have an aura quite unlike the others...)

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
Alright, that's enough! Step back, please, trainers.
Regarding Satono Diamond's trainer assignment...

text_block_list.name: Instructor A
text_block_list.text:
The Satono Group will be conducting official trainer trials following
her debut selection race. Interested parties are requested to apply there.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-I see... Dia-chan's family holds official tryouts for trainers.
You're gonna apply too, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Wait, huh...? Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though I gave it considerable thought... in the end, I decided against applying.
—It simply felt like we were worlds apart.

text_block_list.name: Satono Group Examiner
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Entry No. 28.
Our final candidate, please step forward.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Let's see... This is the last person...
Which means...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(In the end, that trainer didn't come, did they?
The one who looked like they had something to tell me... Why...?)
